test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the sentence using the correct phrasal verb of the underlined word.

You must not __fall out__ your parents, no matter how angry you are.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **fall out with**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"fall out"** means to have a quarrel or disagreement with someone, which may lead to a breakdown of a relationship. (झगड़ा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** They fell out over a trivial matter and haven't spoken since.
 
 
• The correct phrase **"fall out with"** is used to specifically indicate having a disagreement or argument with a particular person. (किसी से झगड़ा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** You must not fall out with your parents, no matter how angry you are.
